item.title: Freshpet Becomes First Dog Food to Earn Clean Label Project Certification
item.description: This certification is awarded by the nonprofit Clean Label Project, which tests products for heavy metals, pesticides and environmental contaminants to evaluate ingredient quality and safety.

item.title: 360training Acquires Canadian Food Safety Group
item.description: The SafeCheck brands will continue certifying Canadian food service professionals under 360training's ownership.

item.title: QuantiPath Introduces Turkey KPI Kits for Salmonella Detection and Quantification
item.description: The kits are designed to help turkey producers detect, quantify and act on Salmonella risk within the same production shift.

item.title: Hormel Sells Whole-Bird Turkey Business to Life-Science Innovations
item.description: LSI will acquire assets from Hormel Foods, including the Melrose, Minn., whole-bird production facility; the Swanville, Minn., feed mill; and associated transportation assets.

item.title: IDFA Promotes Andrew Jerome to VP of Strategic Communications and Executive Director of Foundation
item.description: Jerome joined the International Dairy Foods Association in 2020 and will oversee the development and execution of the association's comprehensive communications strategy in his new role.

item.title: USDA Offloads Washington Buildings in Reorganization Effort
item.description: The agency will dispose of the South Building and Braddock Place as part of its reorganization, which includes a plan to relocate much of its headquarters and staff out of the Washington, D.C., area.

item.title: National Restaurant Association Announces Federal Policy Priorities
item.description: The three federal policy priorities of the National Restaurant Association are: reforming immigration, passing the Credit Card Competition Act and renewing the United States-Mexico-Canada trade agreement.

item.title: Puratos USA to Launch First Professional Chocolate Product with Cultured Cocoa
item.description: The company, in collaboration with California Cultured, will produce the first chocolate product for professionals containing cultured cocoa, which will be commercially available in the United States toward the end of 2026.

item.title: Michigan Officials Warn Recalled ByHeart Infant Formula Remains on Store Shelves
item.description: The formula, recalled in November 2025 and linked to a multistate outbreak of infant botulism, continues to be found for sale in surplus and distressed food sales locations around Michigan, the Michigan Department of Agriculture and Rural Development reported.

item.title: EFSA and FAO Sign Memorandum of Understanding
item.description: The European Food Safety Authority and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations signed a MoU Feb. 19, which will promote science-based solutions for safe, sustainable and resilient food systems, aligned with One Health principles.
